sections.heading: FAQs About Flat Roofs for Belleville Homeowners

faqs.q: How long does a flat roof last on a Belleville two-family or garden apartment?

runs.v: EPDM 15 to 25 years, TPO 7 to 20, modified bitumen 20, and built-up roofing 30, per InterNACHI, with routine inspections twice a year; one that has served Belleville 20 years needs a professional roof inspection.

faqs.q: Why does water pond on my Belleville flat roof, and is it a problem?

runs.v: Below ¼ inch per foot of slope, water ponds; past 48 hours it is a defect, per the NRCA and ARMA, fixed with tapered insulation.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit for flat-roof work in Belleville, NJ?

runs.v: Most residential repairs need none: a detached one- or two-family re-roof is ordinary maintenance under N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7. Substantial projects on other buildings, over 25% of the roof in 12 months, need a permit and may require current-code compliance; confirm with the Belleville construction office.

faqs.q: Does a historic property restrict flat-roof work in Belleville?

faqs.q: Should I repair or replace my Belleville flat roof?

runs.v: Repair damage under 25–30% of the membrane, the 25% rule; replace past that share or when one spot leaks repeatedly, per Modernize and HomeGuide.
